name: FV_DATA_ACT_DEF_HEADERS_
description: This is an audit table that tracks changes to the FV_DATA_ACT_DEF_HEADERS table.

columns.name: DATA_ACT_DEF_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Amount Definition Header.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: DATA_ACT_CODE_NUMBER
columns.description: Code that uniquely identifies the DATA Act amount.

columns.name: AMOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the amount that is defined for DATA Act.

columns.name: AMOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type code for the amount that is defined for DATA Act.

columns.name: FILE_A_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount will be shown in File A.

columns.name: FILE_A_LABEL
columns.description: Label used for the DATA Act amount when it is shown in File A.

columns.name: FILE_A_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Indicates the sequence in which the amount code is processed in File A.

columns.name: FILE_A_CHANGE_SIGN
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount should be displayed by changing its sign when it is displayed in File A.

columns.name: FILE_B_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount will be shown in File B.

columns.name: FILE_B_LABEL
columns.description: Label used for the DATA Act amount when it is shown in File B.

columns.name: FILE_B_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Indicates the sequence in which the amount code is processed in File B.

columns.name: FILE_B_CHANGE_SIGN
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount should be displayed by changing its sign when it is displayed in File B.

columns.name: FILE_C_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount will be shown in File C.

columns.name: FILE_C_LABEL
columns.description: Label used for the DATA Act amount when it is shown in File C.

columns.name: FILE_C_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Indicates the sequence in which the amount code is processed in File C.

columns.name: FILE_C_CHANGE_SIGN
columns.description: Indicates whether the amount should be displayed by changing its sign when it is displayed in File C.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
